subject: Request: Promotional waiver + 7-day eval keepalive for Greenfield Health
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Garcia <susan.garcia@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Greenfield - short ask: promo waiver + 7-day eval keepalive

Hi Susan,

Quick note — we know your procurement team is still routing the PO for the pilot (understandable given year-end workflows). Greenfield has been using the sandbox actively and the engineering team is mid-way through the final integration tests (see summary attached).

To avoid losing momentum, can we approve a short, 7-day eval keepalive for their account and a small promotional waiver that restores 250k token credits? That would keep the proof-of-concept live while procurement finalizes the PO.

If you need a formal waiver letter or an exec sign-off, happy to escalate. Camila (AE) and Lauren (CS) are on copy to coordinate the exact scope.

Thanks — appreciate quick guidance here.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trial-usage-report.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Susan Garcia <susan.garcia@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield - short ask: promo waiver + 7-day eval keepalive

Markus / Camila — thanks for the note and for the usage report. Procurement is indeed still validating budget lines; they told me the PO will clear by next week at the earliest.

Two quick asks from our side before procurement will sign off on any additional credits:
- Can you send a simple waiver letter on company letterhead that states the 7-day extension and the 250k token promo?
- We need a single invoice/quote line item (so finance can track) that shows the promotional credit as a $0 line with expiration date.

If you can provide those, I can flag to procurement to expedite. Otherwise we risk losing a week of engineering time.

—Susan
Director, Vendor Operations
Greenfield Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Garcia <susan.garcia@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, procurement@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield - short ask: promo waiver + 7-day eval keepalive

Hi Susan — thanks, we can do that.

I've attached a short waiver draft and a quote stub that puts the promotional credit on a $0 line with the start/end dates. If that format works for finance, please confirm and I'll route to our finance team for formal sign-off and a PDF on company letterhead.

Plan B: If procurement still needs additional risk controls, we can limit the credit to use on specific routes/models (so it can't be exported to other projects).

Next steps I propose:
1) Susan confirms the quote format is acceptable to procurement.
2) I send official waiver + letterhead PDF (same day) and copy our finance contact for visibility.
3) Markus will confirm the account is toggled for the 7-day keepalive when finance approves.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Attachments included: promo-waiver-draft.docx (DOCX, 9KB); quote-stub.xlsx (XLSX, 6KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: finance-approvals@redwood.ai; Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Susan Garcia <susan.garcia@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Greenfield - promo waiver request — need quick finance sign-off

Forwarding waiver draft & quote requested by Greenfield procurement.

Hi finance team — can you review and confirm a promo-waiver letter on Redwood letterhead and an invoice stub with a $0 promo line for deal GFH-2026-0012? This is a short, commercial gesture (250k token credits + 7-day keepalive) to preserve their pilot while they route a PO.

Why approve: the account has active usage and we expect a mid-sized reserved purchase once PO clears; this prevents churn and preserves the sales window.

Camila attached the draft (pdf / docx). If you can approve, please either: 1) attach the signed PDF here or 2) reply with the approval text we can paste into a letter.

Thanks — Markus

From: finance-approvals@redwood.ai <finance-approvals@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Susan Garcia <susan.garcia@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield - promo waiver request — approved (signed letter attached)

Markus / Camila / Susan — approved. Attached is the signed promo waiver on Redwood letterhead (promo-waiver-letter.pdf). Promo details: 250,000 token credit applied as a $0 invoice line, valid 2026-02-17 through 2026-02-24. Account is toggled for the 7-day keepalive today.

Susan — please confirm receipt and we'll mark the HubSpot deal GFH-2026-0012 as "promo applied." If procurement clears the PO sooner, the promotional credit will be untouched and you can apply the purchase to additional usage as agreed.

Best,
Finance Approvals (on behalf of Redwood Inference)
